page.layout: One block of text in a single column; a woodcut ornament below the text. No margin notes.

main_text.p: uum, ficut stellas cœlorum, & ficut arena quæ est iuxta littus maris: & hæreditabit semen tuum portam inimicorum suorum.
18. Et benedicentur in semine tuo omnes gentes terræ, eò quòd obediuisti voci meæ.
19. Et reuersus est Abraham ad pueros suos, & surrexerunt, & iuerunt pariter ad Beersebah, & habitauit Abraham in Beer sebah.

page.notes: The first line is a fragment running on from the previous page. The number 149 is printed at the top right. Some words at the line ends are cut off at the edge of the scan; the first letters of several lines are partly lost ("uum", "uæ", "emen", "iesgentes", "uos", "Beerscbah", "ebah"), and these are copied as far as they can be read. The woodcut is an ornament and is not transcribed.
